consumerContract.loopAuthority: HTMLAudioElement default false; Game does not set loop
consumerContract.timingAuthority: Game does not read duration/currentTime/ended/timeupdate/playbackRate and does not use audio to gate or synchronize simulation/UI state
consumerContract.failurePolicy: play rejection and construction errors are swallowed; audio is presentation-only and gameplay continues
consumerContract.acceptanceMeaning: Successful target load/play/end plus unchanged gameplay semantics is sufficient even when decoder/container duration boundaries differ. Cross-target sample or audible equivalence is not required.

relevantFinding.condition: all /v3/assets/audio/** requests aborted together with representative sprite media

rationale: Both pinned browser engines load, play, and reach ended for all three exact Ogg bytes without looping.
The Game uses the cues only as one-shot presentation feedback and never treats decoded sample count or media duration as simulation, navigation, commit, resolution, or UI timing authority.

The existing G4 calibration remains fully green when all audio requests are aborted, so a bounded decoder-specific end-boundary difference cannot corrupt authoritative Game state or specialist identity.

The observed 128-sample difference is preserved as evidence rather than normalized away; the omitted reference tail is already inside the authored fade-out and has low amplitude relative to each full cue.

nonClaims: This does not claim cross-browser sample-exact decode or duration equivalence.
This does not claim perceptual or artistic equivalence between Chromium and Firefox playback.
This does not make Game authoritative for Ogg/Vorbis standard semantics; those remain Artifact/Xiph/Khronos-adjacent technical concerns.

This acceptance is specific to the current Station Zero one-shot fail-soft cue role and must not be reused for music loops, rhythm mechanics, lip sync, beat synchronization, sample-accurate sequencing, or timeline-authoritative audio.
This does not establish rights or licensing validity.
